outcome_definition: Outcome = which controls the 3-SNP HRM assay (97 bp amplicon) leaves in the same melting-curve class. The 7 pairs are quoted verbatim from the Results; the 22 singletons are given by the paper only as a count with a genetic-state split (6/8/6/2), NOT enumerated, so no control is named as a singleton here.
